note: TransformerPath Transformer Accessories Directory. Every entry carries a verification_status and verification_date. Verification reflects a website check on the recorded date; entries are informational supplier listings and do not imply verification, endorsement or commercial affiliation. Categories: Buchholz relays, bushings (HV/LV), tap changers (OLTC/DETC), conservator tanks, breathers, radiators/cooling, cooling fans, oil-level indicators, temperature indicators, pressure-relief devices, oil treatment, oil-circulation pumps, monitoring/diagnostic devices, transformer oil/ester, pressboard/insulation, CRGO, copper/CTC, laminated wood, DDP/DPE, test equipment.

suppliers.name: Maschinenfabrik Reinhausen (MR / Reinhausen Group)
suppliers.description: The German market leader in on-load and de-energised tap changers (OLTC/DETC) and transformer control/monitoring. Reinhausen Group supplies tap-change and monitoring equipment to the global transformer industry.

suppliers.name: Weidmann Electrical Technology (Weidmann Group)
suppliers.description: A global leader in transformer insulation and pressboard — transformerboard, cellulose pressboard, DDP/DPE (densified) and laminated wood components for large power transformers.

suppliers.name: Qualitrol Company
suppliers.description: Supplier of transformer monitoring and protective devices — oil-level/temperature indicators, pressure-relief devices, Buchholz relays and condition monitoring for grid assets. Qualitrol also offers digital transformer monitoring.

suppliers.name: Hilliard Corporation (HILCO)
suppliers.description: HILCO — filter and oil-conditioning equipment for transformers, including oil filtration, dehydration and purification systems used to keep insulating oil dry and clean.

suppliers.name: Camille Bauer Metrawatt AG
suppliers.description: Manufacturer of KINAX transformer monitoring instruments — position, oil-level and temperature transmitters for power transformers, plus measurement instrumentation for industrial monitoring.

suppliers.name: ABB (bushings & transformer insulators)
suppliers.description: ABB supplies transformer bushings, HV insulators and insulation components across its electrification portfolio, including the Micafil heritage insulation brand.

suppliers.name: Trench Group / Trench Switzerland (Hitachi Energy)
suppliers.description: Trench Group is a leading maker of HV transformer bushings (incl. RIS/gas-insulated and resin-impregnated types) and instrument transformers, part of the Hitachi Energy portfolio.

suppliers.name: HSP Hochspannungsgheräte GmbH (HSP)
suppliers.description: German manufacturer of high-voltage bushings, condensers and insulation components for power transformers and HV apparatus.

suppliers.name: Fuji Electric Co., Ltd.
suppliers.description: Fuji Electric manufactures transformers and a wide range of transformer components and accessories, including cooling systems and monitoring equipment for power, distribution and dry-type units.

suppliers.name: EMB GmbH (EBErhard Möbius Elektrotechnische Bauelemente)
suppliers.description: German manufacturer of Buchholz relays and transformer protective devices — Buchholz relays, pressure-relief devices and monitoring equipment for power transformers.

suppliers.name: Trantech Radiator Products
suppliers.description: US manufacturer of transformer radiators and cooling equipment — plate-fin and other radiator designs for oil-immersed transformers.

suppliers.name: COMEM Group
suppliers.description: Italian manufacturer of transformer bushings and components, including HV/LV bushings, and monitoring devices for distribution and power transformers.

suppliers.name: Bicron Electronics Company
suppliers.description: US manufacturer of magnetic components and transformers, including high-frequency/power transformers and transformer-related components for industrial applications.

suppliers.name: BTRAC Ltd
suppliers.description: UK transformer-accessories specialist supplying bushings, MR/Messko on-load tap changers, monitoring and retrofit components, cable boxes and electrical fabrications. Corrected: the prompt listed BTRAC as India (btrac.com is a parked domain); the company is UK-based at btracuk.com.

suppliers.name: PRESS-N-FORGE (India)
suppliers.description: Mumbai trader/wholesaler of transformer accessories — silica-gel breathers, bushings, pressure-relief valves and oil-level gauges. Note: PRESS-N-FORGE is an accessories distributor, not a pressboard/insulation manufacturer as the prompt implied.

suppliers.name: Lee Vedla Industrial Corporation
suppliers.description: Bhopal supplier of insulating papers (kraft, crepe, thermally upgraded), CRGO laminations/slit coils and transformer core materials for power and distribution transformer manufacturing.

suppliers.name: SPX Transformer Solutions (Prolec-GE Waukesha)
suppliers.description: Formerly SPX Transformer Solutions — the prompt's "PX Transformer Solutions" / spxtransformer.com are incorrect. Acquired by Prolec GE in Oct 2021 and renamed Prolec-GE Waukesha, Inc.; supplies power transformers, components and accessories. Current site: waukeshatransformers.com.

suppliers.name: ACC Insulations Pvt Ltd
suppliers.description: Manufacturer of transformer electrical insulation components and pressboard since 1994 — insulation kits, pressboard components and densified pressboard parts.

suppliers.name: Umang Boards Ltd
suppliers.description: Manufacturer of pressboard, transformer insulation boards, winding wires and insulating enamels/resins for oil-immersed distribution and power transformers.

suppliers.name: Modern Insulators Ltd
suppliers.description: BSE-listed (515008) ISO 9001/14001/45001 manufacturer of porcelain insulators and transformer bushings for HV and LV applications.
